name: Extra Paragraph Types (EPT): Webform
description: Adds a Webform paragraph type that embeds a selected webform into content, with the shared EPT design settings.

suggests.drupal/ept_webform_popup: Display a button that opens the webform in a popup instead of inline.

project_description: Extra Paragraph Types (EPT): Webform adds a Webform paragraph type. An editor selects an existing webform through a required webform entity-reference field on the paragraph, and the paragraph renders that form inline in the page's flow. It ships no PHP of its own: the paragraph carries the standard EPT title/text fields plus ept_core's field_ept_settings, so it inherits the family's shared Design options (margins, padding, borders, background color/image/video, container width, edge-to-edge). Part of the EPT suite built on ept_core; see EPT Webform Popup for a button-plus-popup variant.
